# Rulebook

Each business rule states what Marjan enforces, the legal or institutional source, how it shows up in practice, and where it is enforced.

| Level | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `program` | Enforced by the Solana program: an invalid transaction fails on-chain. |
| `framework` | Enforced by the reference engine in this framework; next candidate for the program. |
| `advisory` | Raised as an alert for human review; not a legal violation by itself. |
| `human` | A legal judgment that stays human; the protocol records who decided and the evidence hash. |

## Shared purchasing instruments

### PROC-01 · Per-adherent cap: 50% of the registered quantity, rounded down  
`BR` · enforcement: **program**

A non-participating body may adhere to at most 50% of the quantity registered for the item. Fractions are rounded down.

**Sources:** Lei 14.133/2021, art. 86, §4; Decreto 11.462/2023, art. 32, I; Decreto AL 95.019/2023, art. 32, I; TCU Acórdão 547/2026-Plenário, item 9.1.1.6 (round down) and para. 67 (the federal system rounded up)

**Practice:** A state central purchasing body computes 50% of 21 units as 10, 'observada a impossibilidade de fracionamento' (founder field observation).

**Code:** `programs/marjan/src/rules.rs::individual_cap; framework engine PROC-01`

### PROC-02 · Global cap: twice the registered quantity, or the lower tender maximum  
`BR` · enforcement: **program**

All adhesions to an item together may not exceed twice its registered quantity, nor the maximum for non-participants set in the tender; zero forbids adhesions.

**Sources:** Lei 14.133/2021, art. 86, §5; Decreto 11.462/2023, arts. 15, XI and 32, II; TCU Acórdão 1.233/2012-Plenário, item 9.3.2.1.5; TCU Acórdão 547/2026-Plenário, para. 66 (federal system showed balances of -2, -155 and -25)

**Practice:** The federal Gestão de Atas formula: balance for adhesions = maximum - (awaiting authorization + authorized).

**Code:** `programs/marjan/src/rules.rs::adhesion_cap; framework engine PROC-02`

### PROC-03 · Reserve at request; refuse when nothing is available  
`BR` · enforcement: **program**

A request reserves quantity immediately; no request or authorization may proceed when the available balance is zero or negative.

**Sources:** Guia Prático Gestão de Ata SRP/SIASGNet (balance formula); TCU Acórdão 547/2026-Plenário, item 9.1.1.11

**Practice:** State central purchasing body practice: authorization reserves the balance; after use, 'baixa definitiva do saldo' or 'restituição do saldo correspondente' (founder field observation).

**Code:** `programs/marjan/src/instructions/carona.rs::handle_request_adhesion`

### PROC-04 · Supplier acceptance precedes authorization  
`BR` · enforcement: **program**

The managing body authorizes only after the supplier has accepted the adhesion.

**Sources:** Lei 14.133/2021, art. 86, §2, III; Decreto 11.462/2023, art. 31, §1; Decreto AL 95.019/2023, art. 31, §1

**Practice:** In the field, acceptance arrives by e-mail and is attached as a PDF to the process and to Compras.gov.br ('Anexo Aceitação'). Marjan records it as the supplier's signature.

**Code:** `programs/marjan/src/instructions/carona.rs::handle_supplier_respond`

### PROC-05 · No authorization after the record expires  
`BR` · enforcement: **program**

Requests and authorizations are refused outside the validity of the price record, even when the request was filed while it was valid.

**Sources:** Lei 14.133/2021, art. 84; Decreto 11.462/2023, art. 31, caput; TCU Acórdão 547/2026-Plenário, para. 68 and item 9.1.1.7

**Code:** `programs/marjan/src/instructions/carona.rs::handle_authorize_adhesion`

### PROC-06 · Execute within 90 days; extension within validity; lapse releases quantity  
`BR` · enforcement: **program**

After authorization the adherent must contract within 90 days; the manager may extend within validity; after the deadline anyone may lapse the adhesion and its quantity returns to the balance.

**Sources:** Decreto 11.462/2023, art. 31, §§2-3; Decreto AL 95.019/2023, art. 31, §§2-3; TCU Acórdão 547/2026-Plenário, items 9.1.1.9 and 9.1.1.10 (deadline tracked by hand)

**Practice:** Authorization despachos remind the adherent of the 90-day limit in free text.

**Code:** `programs/marjan/src/instructions/carona.rs::handle_expire_adhesion`

### PROC-07 · Roles are fixed: manager, participant, adherent  
`BR` · enforcement: **program**

The manager does not adhere to its own record; a participant is not recorded as an adherent nor vice versa.

**Sources:** Lei 14.133/2021, art. 6, XLVII-XLIX; TCU Acórdão 547/2026-Plenário, item 9.1.1.8 (roles recorded inconsistently)

**Code:** `programs/marjan/src/rules.rs::check_reservation (manager); framework engine (participant)`

### PROC-08 · Federal bodies do not adhere to non-federal records  
`BR` · enforcement: **program**

Federal bodies may not adhere to records managed by state, district or municipal bodies.

**Sources:** Lei 14.133/2021, art. 86, §8; Decreto 11.462/2023, art. 33

**Code:** `programs/marjan/src/rules.rs::check_reservation`

### PROC-09 · Alagoas: state bodies adhere to municipal records only of state capitals  
`BR-AL` · enforcement: **program**

State bodies may not adhere to records managed by municipal bodies, except those managed by municipalities that are state capitals and by the Federal District.

**Sources:** Decreto AL 95.019/2023, art. 33

**Code:** `programs/marjan/src/rules.rs::profile_allows`

### PROC-10 · Exceptions lift the global cap only when they apply, never the per-adherent cap  
`BR` · enforcement: **program**

Emergency health purchases under Ministry of Health records, and subnational adhesions required for voluntary transfers of a federal programme under federal records, are exempt from the 2x cap; the 50% cap still applies.

**Sources:** Lei 14.133/2021, art. 86, §§6-7; Decreto 11.462/2023, art. 32, §§1-2

**Code:** `programs/marjan/src/rules.rs::exception_applies`

### PROC-11 · Participants draw only from their own registered quota  
`BR` · enforcement: **framework**

A participating body uses only the quantity registered for it on that item; a body that is not a participant of the record cannot use it as a participant.

**Sources:** Decreto 11.462/2023, arts. 2, IV and 30; Decreto AL 95.019/2023, arts. 2, IV and 30

**Practice:** Supply authorizations are issued per record 'ao órgão participante, tendo em vista que existe saldo de demanda'; items of a record where the body is not a participant are refused (founder field observation).

**Code:** `framework engine PROC-11`

### PROC-12 · Rectifying an authorization restores the balance  
`BR` · enforcement: **framework**

When an authorization is rectified downward or not used, the difference returns to the available balance; it never increases the registered quantity.

**Sources:** Decreto 11.462/2023, art. 23 (no increases); Decreto AL 95.019/2023, art. 23

**Practice:** Authorizations are re-issued as 'RETIFICAÇÃO' after budget review (founder field observation).

**Code:** `framework engine PROC-12`

### PROC-13 · Every adhesion goes through the system of record  
`BR` · enforcement: **program**

Adhesion requests made outside the system of record are not accepted.

**Sources:** TCU Acórdão 547/2026-Plenário, item 9.1.3.2

**Practice:** The same adhesion is recorded in the electronic process, in Compras.gov.br and in an internal control system or spreadsheet (founder field observation).

**Code:** `by construction: a quantity can only be reserved by a program instruction`

### PROC-14 · Registered, contracted and remaining quantities are public per item  
`BR` · enforcement: **program**

Managing bodies publish registered quantities, contracts made and balances per item.

**Sources:** Nota Recomendatória Conjunta Atricon/IRB/CNPTC/Abracom/Audicon 01/2025; TCU Acórdão 547/2026-Plenário, para. 81 and item 9.1.2.2

**Code:** `public program accounts (AtaItem, AgencyItemUsage, AdhesionRequest)`

### PROC-15 · Object-level aggregation alert  
`BR` · enforcement: **advisory**

When one body adheres to several items of the same object, report its share of the object's total registered quantity.

**Sources:** Open question: art. 86 §4 is written per item

**Practice:** A body needing 18 units, capped at 10 on one item, reached 18 by adhering to three items with the same description and price (founder field observation).

**Code:** `framework engine PROC-15`

### EU-01 · Framework agreements state a maximum and are exhausted when it is reached  
`EU` · enforcement: **framework**

The notice states the maximum quantity or value; once reached, the framework agreement has no further effect.

**Sources:** Directive 2014/24/EU, arts. 5(5) and 33; CJEU C-216/17 Coopservice (2018), paras. 60-61; CJEU C-23/20 Simonsen & Weel (2021), operative part 1 and paras. 54, 67-68

**Code:** `framework engine EU-01`

### EU-02 · Only authorities identified in the notice may call off  
`EU` · enforcement: **framework**

Call-offs are limited to contracting authorities clearly identified in the call for competition.

**Sources:** Directive 2014/24/EU, art. 33(2) and recital 60; CJEU C-216/17, para. 56

**Code:** `framework engine EU-02`

### EU-03 · Optional per-authority split of the maximum  
`EU` · enforcement: **framework**

The maximum may be divided among the participating authorities, each with its own figure.

**Sources:** CJEU C-23/20, paras. 78-79

**Code:** `framework engine EU-03`


## Payment obligations and financing

### PAY-01 · Liquidation before payment or financing  
`BR` · enforcement: **program**

A debt exists for the protocol only after liquidation (origin, amount and creditor verified) signed by the debtor body.

**Sources:** Lei 4.320/1964, art. 63

**Code:** `programs/marjan/src/instructions/obligation.rs::handle_register_obligation`

### PAY-02 · Chronological payment order per funding source and category  
`BR` · enforcement: **framework**

Payments follow the order in which claims became payable, per funding source and category (goods, leases, services, works); a deviation needs a prior justification in a listed case and is published.

**Sources:** Lei 14.133/2021, art. 141, §§1-3; Código Penal, art. 337-H; Atricon Resolução 03/2022

**Code:** `framework payments.PaymentQueue`

### PAY-03 · Two months of delay lets the supplier suspend  
`BR` · enforcement: **framework**

A payment delay of more than two months from the invoice entitles the supplier to suspend performance or terminate.

**Sources:** Lei 14.133/2021, art. 137, §2, IV and §3, II

**Code:** `framework payments.overdue_flags`

### PAY-04 · One receivable, one cumulative financing limit  
`GLOBAL` · enforcement: **program**

The total financed against a receivable never exceeds its eligible amount; a fiscal document backs only one receivable.

**Sources:** Design rule; analogous to the uniqueness guarantee of registered card receivables (Resolução CMN 4.734/2019) and electronic duplicatas (Lei 13.775/2018); Failure cases: Qingdao duplicate warehouse receipts (conviction, 2018); First Brands and Tricolor (2025, alleged)

**Code:** `programs/marjan/src/rules.rs::finance; FiscalDocument PDA`

### PAY-05 · Assignment requires notice to the debtor  
`BR` · enforcement: **program**

Financing requires the creditor's signature and evidence that the debtor was notified.

**Sources:** Código Civil, art. 290

**Code:** `programs/marjan/src/instructions/obligation.rs::handle_finance`

### PAY-06 · AntecipaGov profile: 70% of the remaining balance, follow-ons with the same bank  
`BR` · enforcement: **framework**

Advances against a federal contract are limited to 70% of what remains to be paid; a second operation on the same contract must be with the same bank; the body pays into the linked account.

**Sources:** IN SEGES/MGI 82/2025, arts. 2, 12 and Annex 1.3

**Code:** `framework payments.AntecipaGovProfile`

### PAY-07 · Public authorities pay within 30 days (60 for public health)  
`EU` · enforcement: **framework**

Payment terms of public authorities may not exceed 30 days from the invoice, or 60 for public healthcare entities.

**Sources:** Directive 2011/7/EU, art. 4(3)-(6); CJEU C-122/18 Commission v Italy (2020)

**Code:** `framework payments.overdue_flags`
